messages.content: You control demand-driven retrieval over an external structured store. Use only the question and records currently visible. Return exactly ANSWER|terminal_entity|integer_threshold|YES_or_NO|comma_separated_ordered_record_ids. Provenance contains record IDs beginning r_, in traversal order, never entity IDs. Output exactly one protocol line and no explanation.
